(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))
                                (* (- (obj-h obj) 2) (- (obj-w obj) 2))))
           (all? (lambda (p)
                   (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj))
                       (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                 (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (paint-frame out frame)
      (let ((a (at g (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1)))
            (b (at g (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (- (obj-c2 frame) 1))))
        (for*/fold ([acc out])
                   ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-r2 frame))]
                    [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
          (set-cell acc r c (if (= (modulo (- c (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1)) 2) 0) a b)))))
    (let ((frames (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0))))
      (for/fold ([out (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                         (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 1) 1 0)))])
                ([frame (in-list frames)])
        (paint-frame out frame)))))
